name: crash-backoff-and-stop
description: A crashed instance restarts with backoff from 1 s up to 60 s; five crashes in ten minutes stops it with one notification per module per sign-in. Notices by events only (process handle, pipe close).

steps.event: crash 1 at t=0 s (process handle signalled)
crash 5 at t=500 s (all within 10 minutes)
state = crash-stopped; exactly one notification via hub.notify
